ai_summary: Aegis Logistics' wholly-owned subsidiary, Sea Lord Containers Limited (SCL), has secured a significant INR 37.17 Crore construction contract from Konkan Storage Systems (Kochi) Private Limited (KCPL), a related entity. This agreement entails SCL building 49,577 cbm liquid storage tanks and associated facilities, representing a material revenue intake for Aegis Logistics, with the entire sum payable upon execution. While this is a related party transaction, the company declares it has been conducted on an 'arm's length basis,' mitigating potential red flags.
